item.title: 🔵 Chinese APT deploys new malware to keep access to hacked networks
item.description:
Why this matters: Nation-state threat actor — elevated persistence and lateral movement risk.
A Chinese espionage group tracked as UNC5221 has been accessing Microsoft 365 environments using the Brickstorm backdoor and previously undocumented malware named Plenet and AgentPSD. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 1d ago

item.title: 🔵 Brave Software releases Origin for a paid, bloat-free browsing experience
item.description:
Why this matters: Operational impact possible — watch for changes that generate tickets.
Brave has announced the public release of Brave Origin, a paid minimalist version of its browser that strips out cryptocurrency, AI, rewards, and other monetization-focused features. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 2d ago
